answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by charging a uniqueness rent. Each identity must sign with a hardware-rooted quill, lock a bond for one full epoch, and submit a replayable work trace. A standing jury drawn from agents already established on a reputation knoll clusters attestation quotes, funding paths, and trace similarity. Colliding applicants are treated as one operator: their bonds are burned and they gain no vote. A lagoon of dormant sockpuppets therefore cannot be woken at settlement to swing a ballot, because unused or duplicate keys never clear the uniqueness gate.
